content.query:
// Only works for IPv4 Addresses
let GeoIPDB_FULL = _GetWatchlist("geoip");
let AzureActivityRecords = AzureActivity
| where Caller contains "@"
| where isnotempty(parse_ipv4(CallerIpAddress))
| where OperationNameValue endswith "WRITE"
| where ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| summarize ResouceCreationCount = count() by Caller, CallerIpAddress;
AzureActivityRecords
| evaluate ipv4_lookup(GeoIPDB_FULL, CallerIpAddress, network)
| extend CallerPrefix = split(Caller, "@")[0]
| extend friendly_label = strcat(CallerPrefix, " - ", cityname, ", ", countryname)
| project Caller,
          CallerPrefix,
          CallerIpAddress,
          ResouceCreationCount,
          Country = countryname,
          City = cityname,
          Latitude = latitude,
          Longitude = longitude,
          friendly_label
